goal: Create a photorealistic premium fashion commercial cut using back_master.png as the primary visual source of truth, showcasing the rear back neckline, dori ties, handcrafted golden latkan tassels, expansive flared kalis, and subtle wind-blown champagne satin backdrop dynamics with strictly zero profile or face reveal.

engine_specs.camera_profile: High-end digital cinema fashion capture, clean color science, warm 3200K studio exposure

identity.instruction: Preserve the exact rear-view hairstyle, wavy dark brown strands cascading down the back and over the shoulders, shoulder width, and elegant posture. Strictly zero face or profile reveal.
identity.view_lock: Full back-view throughout the entire duration (rotation <= 5 degrees)

attire.instruction: Preserve the exact deep scooped rear neckline, delicate maroon dori cords tied at the nape, handcrafted golden latkan tassels swaying gently, 3/4 fitted sleeves with zari borders, and voluminous 16-kali skirt flare.

accessories.instruction: Maintain the cream flat leather sandals and minimal wrist adornment exactly as shown.

environment_setup.location_type: Luminous champagne satin fabric studio set
environment_setup.backdrop_instruction: Maintain the ivory/champagne satin backdrop with draped folds and floor pool. Background fabric exhibits subtle, elegant wind-blown drift.
environment_setup.lighting_instruction: 3200K warm tungsten key lighting highlighting the depth of maroon georgette, the glint of golden tassels, and the champagne fabric sheen.

motion_safety_rules.body_orientation: Keep the model strictly back-facing. Rotation strictly limited to under 5 degrees so side profile and face remain entirely hidden.
motion_safety_rules.turn_limit: Strictly no turns, no spins, no side reveals, no head-turning toward camera.
motion_safety_rules.identity_lock: Maintain dark brown wavy hair texture and shoulder proportions consistently. No morphing of hair or dress.
motion_safety_rules.garment_lock: Keep rear neckline, dori ties, latkan tassels, and kali panel seams visually identical in every frame.
motion_safety_rules.background_lock: Champagne satin backdrop remains locked with only subtle fluid ripple permitted.
motion_safety_rules.motion_style: Subtle and regal: gentle micro-breathing, soft swaying of the golden latkan tassels, faint flutter of the skirt hem.

motion_plan.core_goal: Deliver an exquisite 6-second rear showcase of the gown's back cut, latkan tassels, and expansive kali sweep with slow vertical jib or slow push-in.
motion_plan.camera_motion: Very slow subtle push-in or slight upward jib pedestal movement emphasizing gown height, regal posture, and tassel detail.
motion_plan.subject_motion: Tiny natural breathing, subtle weight balance shift, gentle swaying of the hanging golden tassels.
motion_plan.fabric_motion: The background satin fabric ripples very slowly in an expensive, faint breeze; skirt hem shows delicate micro-flutter.
motion_plan.hair_motion: Very slight natural swaying of wavy hair strands against the upper back.

timeline_sequence.action: Hold back anchor pose from back_master.png. Golden latkan tassels hang center back. Backdrop satin begins subtle gentle ripple.
Camera executes gentle slow push-in. Tassels exhibit tiny, elegant pendulum sway. Gown kalis catch warm golden highlights.
Motion settles smoothly into a regal, calm back presentation. Video loops or cuts smoothly.

negative_prompt: face, eyes, nose, mouth, profile, side view, turning around, front view, cleavage, necklace, face morphing, identity drift, garment redesign, flickering, jitter, low quality, messy hair, changing dress color, extra limbs, hand distortion, background shifting, aggressive motion, sudden movements
